semiconductor_relevance: High — Daiko Seisakusho manufactures critical materials and components used in semiconductor manufacturing processes.
summary: Daiko Seisakusho specializes in the production of quartz glass products and components such as silicon carbide, fused quartz glass, and sapphire, which are essential for semiconductor applications. The company also offers ceramic and oxide ceramic fixtures, as well as various plumbing fittings, supporting the semiconductor manufacturing infrastructure.
capabilities: Production of fused quartz glass products
Supply of ceramic and oxide ceramic fixtures
Provision of plumbing fittings like pipes, tubing, and connectors
